Taplist

1.

2. Raspberry Sour (5.7% ABV)

Juicy red raspberries blended with the bright lactic acidity of the kettle-soured base for a refreshing beer. Our Raspberry Sour pours with a beautiful pink hue, greeting you with a bouquet of ripe fruit and crisp tartness.

3. ENIAC Mosaic IPA (6.2% ABV)

Our Mosaic IPA features flavors of tropical fruit and blueberry resulting in a bold hop profile with restrained bitterness. Named after the first general purpose computer, the ENIAC set the foundation for the technological revolution. Our flagship IPA pays homage to the American creative spirit and served as the catalyst for Lucky Envelope’s brewing evolution.

4. Grapefruit IPA (6.2% ABV)

As fresh as the first cut, our Grapefruit IPA sends you on an easy-going vacation in a glass. Pouring a lovely light orange color, this beer greets you with zesty aromatic notes of citrus and bursts with fresh grapefruit flavor.

5. Fresh Hop Strata Hazy IPA (6.3% ABV)

Fresh off the bine and only hours old, our Strata Fresh Hop IPA celebrates the beautiful essence of this once-a-year harvest. Strata originated at Oregon State's Aroma Hop Breeding Program and is known for flavors of juicy tropical and stone fruits layered in with dark cannabis.

6. Rivers and Roads IPA (5.7% ABV)

We're excited to partner with Remlinger Brewery to bring you this tropical-forward IPA. Brewed for The Head and The Heart's 2-day concert at Remlinger Farms. Hopped with Citra, Nelson Sauvin, Strata, and Centennial Incognito, and fermented with Fermentis' new SH-45 lager strain.

7. Ube Vanilla Cream Stout (5.7% ABV)

In celebration of Mid-Autumn Festival, we drew inspiration from Ube Halaya, a traditional Filipino jam made with purple yam and vanilla. We brewed sweet ube and loads of vanilla beans into our rich cream stout, resulting in a velvety rich beer with layers of chocolate, earthy sweetness, and a smooth finish.

Allergen Warning: Lactose

8. Oolong Tea Lager (4.9% ABV)

Happy Mid-Autumn Festival! This beer was inspired by yum cha, the Cantonese tradition of enjoying dim sum alongside tea. We brewed a crisp rice lager with f loral and earthy oolong tea to create a refreshing food-friendly beer that pairs especially well with dumplings and rice dishes.

9. Guava Lava Sour w/Thai Chilies (5.7% ABV)

A tart, refreshing ale that pairs juicy guava puree with the spicy kick of Thai bird's eye chilis. The floral tropical sweetness balances beautifully against the bright acidity and moderate chili heat, creating a layered flavor profile that evolves with each sip.

10. Ground Provisions Harvest Lager (5.5% ABV)

Collaboration with White Bluffs Brewing

A historic lager brewed with sweet and russet potatoes, crafted in collaboration with White Bluffs Brewing and our friend Larry Rock. The name honors the starchy crops African-Caribbean slaves grew for sustenance, while the beer itself reimagines the German pre-Reinheitsgebot Kartoffelbier.

13. Pumpkin Emoji Cream Stout (6.0% ABV)

The Pumpkin Emoji Cream Stout is how we imagine fall would taste if it were squeezed into a glass. Real pumpkin puree and a mix of pie spices blend deliciously with the stout's flavors of cocoa and coffee beans. Lactose and flaked oats balance out bold dark malts creating a creamy smoothness not unlike a "PSL"-perfectly spiced latte.

Allergen Warning: Lactose

11. Pineapple Whip Sour Ale (5.7% ABV)

Fruited sour brewed with pineapple soft serve, pineapple puree, and coconut. Because no trip to a mouse-themed amusement park or the Puyallup Fair is complete without pineapple whip.

14. Yinz Jawn Pennsylvania Lager (4.6% ABV)

2026 World Beer Cup Silver Medal

The Yinz Jawn Lager is our take on the classic Pennsylvania Amber Lager, a style rooted in the legacy of America's oldest brewery. This beer started as a collaboration between Rob (Yinz) of Triceratops Brewing and Barry (Jawn) of Lucky Envelope, and is brewed with corn, Weyermann malt, and German hops as a nod to our shared Pennsylvania Dutch roots. Yinz thirsty? Grab some of this jawn!

12. Fresh Hop Lórien Pilsner (5.0% ABV)

Our light, crispy Fresh Hop Pilsner steeped with hours-old Oregon Lórien hops. Lórien hops were developed by Indie Hops as a cross between Sterling and a German male hop. Lórien is known for its notes of wildflower, hay, lime zest, and a touch of cinnamon spice.

15. Baja Blurst Hard Seltzer (5.2% ABV)

Our house-made Hard Seltzer flavored like the nationally recognized, cult-classic fast-food soda. Baja Blurst Hard Seltzer will leave you feeling like doing something XtrEme, like scaling Mount Rainier or jet skiing circles around Puget Sound.
